items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a duo concert with Lacy.

ctx.x: Here’s another solo soprano record called The Tree that you did in Milan.

Okay. I did a duo concert with Lacy. This is a great story. I didn’t tell this, didn’t talk about this story. It’s a nice story. It’s what it is. Italian promoter. Lacy is very popular in Italy, and I’m the new soprano guy, blah blah blah. So they put together Lacy and Liebman in St. Stephan’s Church, giant church in Florence. Now Steve I met once with Miles. I didn’t know him, but certainly knew of him, obviously. I don’t know if he really knew me or what. But anyway – she was with me – he’s – did you know him?
